title: Arrogant Magic Tutor Underestimates Toddler Prodigy — Part 2

series.summary: Rudeus gets caught casting water magic by his mother Zenith, sparking a parenting dispute with Paul that leads to hiring the aloof Migurd mage Roxy as his private tutor.

series_summary: Rudeus gets caught casting water magic by his mother Zenith, sparking a parenting dispute with Paul that leads to hiring the aloof Migurd mage Roxy as his private tutor.

cuts.voiceover_text: Zenith catches young Rudeus casting magic, triggering a fierce clash between his parents over his future.
cuts.raw_narration: Zenith catches young Rudeus casting magic, triggering a fierce clash between his parents over his future.

cuts.voiceover_text: Paul wants him to train as a swordsman. But Zenith insists their toddler is a prodigy, forcing Paul to hire an elite tutor.
cuts.raw_narration: Paul wants him to train as a swordsman. But Zenith insists their toddler is a prodigy, forcing Paul to hire an elite tutor.

cuts.voiceover_text: A cloaked rider arrives on horseback. Roxy Migurdia dismounts, carrying an oversized wizard staff and wearing a pointed hat.
cuts.raw_narration: A cloaked rider arrives on horseback. Roxy Migurdia dismounts, carrying an oversized wizard staff and wearing a pointed hat.

cuts.voiceover_text: Convinced the parents are exaggerating a spoiled toddler's basic party tricks, Roxy skeptically leads Rudeus outside to the open fields. What will she do when she realizes the true scale of his magic?
